source.note: Current-generation published specifications; verify the physical machine year and options.

layout_drawing.title: Machine Layout Drawing, Mini Mill/Super Mini Mill, 2/10/2022
layout_drawing.note: Heights assume the suggested 76 mm leveling pad height. Sheet-metal stack-up tolerance +/-13 mm. The drawing gives Y travel 12 in (305 mm); check against travels.y for your machine year.

enclosure_estimates.note: Values marked published come from the layout drawing; the rest are estimates. Measure your machine and change status to measured.

door_opening_width.note: layout drawing p3, DOOR WIDTH 25.73 in

door_opening_bottom_from_floor.note: from the GrabCAD model front panel

door_opening_top_from_floor.note: from the GrabCAD model front panel

front_wall_to_table_center.note: layout drawing p3, SPINDLE DEPTH 23.43 in; table centred under the spindle

robot_exchange_pose.note: Table jog before robot entry so the vise is out from under the spindle and closer to the door. Uses Y travel toward the door and X travel sideways; keep inside published travels.

table_shift_toward_door.note: front end of the 305 mm Y travel on the layout drawing (half travel from centre); the robot cannot reach the vise with less

table_shift_sideways.note: not needed: at the front of Y travel the vise is already ~210 mm clear of the spindle
